mapper.sql: s.ses_id as sessionId, s.ses_appointment_id as appointmentId, s.ses_candidate_id as candidateId, s.ses_position_id as positionId, s.ses_interviewer_id as interviewerId, s.ses_cascade_round as roundNo, s.ses_mode as mode, s.ses_status as status, s.ses_start_at as startAt, s.ses_end_at as endAt, s.ses_room_id as roomId, s.ses_room_token as roomToken, s.ses_auto_recording as autoRecording, s.ses_candidate_consent as consent, s.ses_consent_at as consentAt, s.ses_rec_url as recUrl, s.ses_rec_duration_sec as recDurationSec, s.ses_rec_access_level as recAccessLevel, p.pos_title as positionTitle, p.pos_company_id as companyId, t.tal_user_id as candidateUserId, ifnull(u.nick_name, u.user_name) as candidateName, ifnull(iu.nick_name, iu.user_name) as interviewerName, date_format(a.apt_start_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as appointmentStartAt, date_format(a.apt_end_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as appointmentEndAt, timestampdiff(minute, a.apt_start_time, a.apt_end_time) as durationMinutes, ifnull(tpl.itl_total_rounds, 1) as totalRounds, ifnull(m.mst_current_question, 0) as answeredCount, ifnull(m.mst_total_question, 0) as totalQuestionNo

from t_int_session s left join t_sch_appointment a on a.apt_id = s.ses_appointment_id left join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id left join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id left join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id left join sys_user iu on iu.user_id = s.ses_interviewer_id left join t_int_template tpl on tpl.itl_id = s.ses_template_id left join t_int_meeting_state m on m.mst_session_id = s.ses_id
mapper.select: select bnd_company_id from t_cmp_binding where bnd_user_id = #{userId} and bnd_status = 1 limit 1

select
where s.ses_status in (0, 1) and (t.tal_user_id = #{userId} or s.ses_interviewer_id = #{userId}) order by (s.ses_status = 1) desc, a.apt_start_time asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_int_meeting_state (mst_session_id, mst_total_question, mst_current_question, mst_duration_seconds, mst_remaining_seconds, mst_created_at, mst_updated_at) select s.ses_id, (select count(*) from t_int_outline o where o.oln_session_id = s.ses_id), 0, timestampdiff(second, a.apt_start_time, a.apt_end_time), timestampdiff(second, a.apt_start_time, a.apt_end_time), sysdate(), sysdate() from t_int_session s left join t_sch_appointment a on a.apt_id = s.ses_appointment_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId} on duplicate key update mst_session_id = mst_session_id
mapper.select: select m.mst_total_question as totalQuestionNo, m.mst_current_question as answeredCount, m.mst_duration_seconds as durationSeconds, m.mst_remaining_seconds as remainingSeconds, m.mst_mic_enabled as micEnabled, m.mst_cam_enabled as camEnabled, m.mst_speaker_volume as speakerVolume, m.mst_cam_status as camStatus, m.mst_mic_status as micStatus, m.mst_speaker_status as speakerStatus, m.mst_net_status as netStatus, m.mst_net_rtt_ms as rttMs, m.mst_net_bandwidth_kbps as bandwidthKbps, m.mst_risk_flag as riskFlag, m.mst_takeover as takeover, m.mst_takeover_reason as takeoverReason, date_format(m.mst_heartbeat_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as heartbeatAt, if(s.ses_status = 1 and s.ses_start_at is not null, timestampdiff(second, s.ses_start_at, sysdate()), 0) as elapsedSeconds, s.ses_status as sessionStatus from t_int_meeting_state m join t_int_session s on s.ses_id = m.mst_session_id where m.mst_session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.update: update t_int_meeting_state set mst_cam_status = #{camStatus}, mst_mic_status = #{micStatus}, mst_speaker_status = #{speakerStatus}, mst_net_status = #{netStatus}, mst_net_rtt_ms = #{rttMs,jdbcType=INTEGER}, mst_net_bandwidth_kbps = #{bandwidthKbps,jdbcType=INTEGER}, mst_risk_flag = #{riskFlag}, mst_device_json = #{deviceJson,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, mst_updated_at = sysdate() where mst_session_id = #{sessionId}
update t_int_meeting_state set mst_takeover = #{takeover}, mst_takeover_reason = #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, mst_updated_at = sysdate() where mst_session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: select ifnull(max(dlg_order), 0) + 1 from t_int_dialogue where dlg_session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_int_dialogue (dlg_session_id, dlg_order, dlg_role, dlg_type, dlg_content, dlg_intent, dlg_created_at) values (#{sessionId}, #{order}, #{role}, #{type}, #{content}, #{intent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, sysdate())
mapper.select: select dlg_id as id, dlg_order as sequence, dlg_role as role, dlg_content as content, date_format(dlg_created_at, '%H:%i:%s') as at from t_int_dialogue where dlg_session_id = #{sessionId} and dlg_order > #{afterSequence} order by dlg_order asc limit #{limit}

select oln_id as questionId, oln_topic as topic, oln_description as description, oln_dimension as dimension from t_int_outline where oln_session_id = #{sessionId} order by oln_order asc, oln_id asc limit #{offset}, 1

select cpt_id as id, cpt_seq as seq, cpt_mode as mode, cpt_content as content, cpt_reference as reference, cpt_points as points, cpt_status as status, cpt_adopted_content as adoptedContent, date_format(cpt_created_at, '%H:%i:%s') as at from t_int_copilot where cpt_session_id = #{sessionId} and cpt_seq > #{afterSequence} order by cpt_seq asc limit #{limit}
mapper.update: update t_int_copilot set cpt_status = #{status}, cpt_adopted_content = #{adoptedContent,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, cpt_updated_at = sysdate() where cpt_id = #{id}
update t_int_session set ses_candidate_consent = #{consent}, ses_consent_at = sysdate(), ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId}
update t_int_session set ses_status = 1, ses_start_at = sysdate(), ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId} and ses_status = 0

update t_int_session set ses_status = #{status}, ses_end_at = sysdate(), ses_rec_duration_sec = if(ses_start_at is null, ses_rec_duration_sec, timestampdiff(second, ses_start_at, sysdate())), ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId}

update t_int_session set ses_status = 3, ses_end_at = sysdate(), ses_rec_duration_sec = if(ses_start_at is null, ses_rec_duration_sec, timestampdiff(second, ses_start_at, sysdate())), ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: select s.ses_id as sessionId, s.ses_status as status, s.ses_mode as mode, date_format(s.ses_start_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as startAt, date_format(s.ses_end_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as endAt, ifnull(s.ses_rec_duration_sec, if(s.ses_start_at is null, 0, timestampdiff(second, s.ses_start_at, ifnull(s.ses_end_at, sysdate())))) as durationSeconds, ifnull(m.mst_current_question, 0) as answeredCount, ifnull(m.mst_total_question, 0) as totalQuestionNo, (select count(*) from t_int_evaluation e where e.evl_session_id = s.ses_id) as reportGenerated from t_int_session s left join t_int_meeting_state m on m.mst_session_id = s.ses_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId}
select ifnull(sum(s.ses_rec_duration_sec), 0) from t_int_session s join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id where p.pos_company_id = #{companyId}

select s.ses_id as sessionId, s.ses_rec_url as recUrl, ifnull(s.ses_rec_duration_sec, 0) as durationSec, ifnull(u.nick_name, u.user_name) as candidateName, p.pos_title as positionTitle, date_format(s.ses_end_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as interviewDate, s.ses_rec_access_level as recAccessLevel, date_format(s.ses_rec_expires_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as recExpiresAt from t_int_session s join t_pos p on p.pos_id = s.ses_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = s.ses_candidate_id join sys_user u on u.user_id = t.tal_user_id where s.ses_id = #{sessionId}

select d.dlg_order as sequence, d.dlg_role as role, d.dlg_content as content, greatest(ifnull(timestampdiff(second, s.ses_start_at, d.dlg_created_at), 0), 0) as second from t_int_dialogue d left join t_int_session s on s.ses_id = d.dlg_session_id where d.dlg_session_id = #{sessionId} order by d.dlg_order asc
mapper.update: update t_int_session set ses_rec_access_level = #{level}, ses_rec_expires_at = date_add(sysdate(), interval #{validDays} day), ses_updated_at = sysdate() where ses_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.select: select rcp_id as policyId, rcp_company_id as companyId, rcp_keep_days as keepDays, rcp_max_storage_gb as maxStorageGb, rcp_default_access_level as defaultAccessLevel from t_int_recording_policy where rcp_company_id = #{companyId} or rcp_company_id is null order by (rcp_company_id is null) asc limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into t_int_recording_policy (rcp_company_id, rcp_keep_days, rcp_max_storage_gb, rcp_created_at, rcp_updated_at) values (#{companyId}, #{keepDays}, #{maxStorageGb}, sysdate(), sysdate()) on duplicate key update rcp_keep_days = #{keepDays}, rcp_max_storage_gb = #{maxStorageGb}, rcp_updated_at = sysdate()
